The chart has three call sites, all in two files. They're listed best first, and the framework definition is last.

`reportError` is defined in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-error-handling/src/index.ts:56`. It wraps the value with `ensureErrorObject` and rethrows it inside a `setTimeout`, so it reports asynchronously through the global error handler. Any change to that would affect the three call sites below:

- **`useOrderableConceptSets`** (line 73) calls `reportError(error)` in a `useEffect` when the SWR error changes. A change in timing or error propagation would alter this hook's error reporting.
- **`useOrderableConceptSWR`** (line 36) is a separate `useEffect` in the same file that also reports the SWR error. The same reasoning applies.
- **`useFavoritesActions` / `persistFavorites`** (line 57) calls `reportError(error)` in a `catch` before showing an error snackbar and returning `false`. If `reportError` started throwing synchronously, that `catch` would propagate the exception instead of returning `false`.

The chart-wide search found no other uses, including tests or mocks. Inside the framework itself, `current-user.ts`, `esm-styleguide/src/modals/index.tsx` and the framework's own tests also call it, but those are not part of the chart app.
